subject.title: fix(openclaw): make provider readiness contracts truthful

question: Should this PR split and defer the accepted-event gate, or expand to implement a truthful accepted recorder-event contract across all supported providers?
rationale: The current gate is incorrect, while its complete repair changes a shared event contract and provider request outcome semantics across seven servers.

options.title: Split and defer the gate
options.body: Land the backward-compatible readiness terminology separately and implement server-owned accepted outcomes in a focused follow-up.

options.title: Expand this PR
options.body: Add truthful accepted outcomes and end-to-end coverage for every provider before retaining the gate.

recommendation.title: Split and defer the gate
recommendation.body: Land the backward-compatible readiness terminology separately and implement server-owned accepted outcomes in a focused follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and most recently changed the shared recorder, OpenClaw adapter, lifecycle, and artifact contracts involved.
